entries.claim_text: Kimi K3 architecture: each block is 3 KDA + 1 Gated MLA, each attention layer paired with Stable LatentMoE, AttnRes over embedding and preceding blocks, MoonViT-V2 vision pathway
entries.quoted_snippet: Each block contains three Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) layers followed by one Gated MLA layer

entries.claim_text: Fitted scaling-law curves: Kimi K3 reaches the same validation loss at ~2.5x fewer FLOPs than Kimi K2
entries.quoted_snippet: Fitted scaling-law curves for Kimi K2 and Kimi K3

entries.claim_text: Lower-bounded decay: Kimi Linear uses unbounded negative-Softplus while Kimi K3 bounds log-decay with a scaled sigmoid; the bounded range lets all causal tiles use dense Tensor Core matrix multiplications instead of position-pair diagonal computation
entries.quoted_snippet:
Kimi Linear uses an unbounded negative-Softplus
mapping, whereas Kimi K3 bounds the log-decay with a scaled sigmoid; the curves show A = 0 and gmin = −5. (b) Kimi Linear
evaluates each diagonal tile with an explicit position-pair computation, while the bounded range in Kimi K3 allows all causal tiles to

entries.claim_text: Vision-tower gradient norms: from-scratch MoonViT-V2 maintains lower gradient norms with fewer spikes than SigLIP-initialized MoonViT-3D, indicating more stable optimization
entries.quoted_snippet:
Compared with the SigLIP-initialized MoonViT-3D, the
from-scratch MoonViT-V2 maintains lower gradient norms with fewer spikes, indicating more stable optimization.

entries.claim_text: Scores and average assistant steps across eight public and in-house RL evaluations rise as RL FLOPs scale, with tool-call steps scaling up consistently
entries.quoted_snippet:
Scores and the average assistant steps across a variety of public and in-house evaluations during RL. By scaling RL FLOPs,
tool-call steps scale up consistently, accompanied by a comprehensive improvement in the model’s overall capability.

entries.claim_text: Completion curves on Camera Repair Management System: Kimi K3 reaches 1.000 vs Opus 4.8 0.918, GPT-5.5 0.893, Kimi K2.6 0.560
entries.quoted_snippet:
Completion curves on Camera Repair Management System, a black-box system replication task in which the agent
reconstructs a hidden 3D-camera repair system as a web application through oracle queries. Completion denotes verifier-assessed

entries.claim_text: Score vs per-task inference cost on four suites; Kimi K3 sits on or near the cost-efficiency frontier but is not top-scoring on the GDPval-AA v2 and AA-Briefcase Elo suites
entries.quoted_snippet:
Overall, Kimi K3 sits on or near the cost-efficiency frontier across all four suites, delivering near-top scores at a fraction
of the cost of Claude Fable 5 in particular.
